images.prompt: Create an original natural color still-life photograph of exactly three yellow-green pears and one small plain pewter jug on a dark oak table. Two pears stand upright at lower left; the third lies on its side just behind them with its stem pointing right. The jug stands at upper right with one handle on its right and one short spout facing left. A single folded cream linen cloth lies beneath part of the jug and extends toward the lower-right corner. Soft daylight comes from a window outside the frame at upper left, with moderate normal photographic exposure so all objects remain clearly visible. Plain charcoal plaster wall behind. No people, extra fruit, plates, flowers, labels or decoration. Vertical 4:5 image, exactly 1024x1280 pixels. Full objects inside the composition, realistic textures, no text, watermark, frame or painterly treatment.

review.reason: Independently inspected natural still life with exactly three pears, one complete pewter jug with open mouth and right handle, and folded linen. Object contacts, stems, metal patina and upper-left illumination are coherent and unbranded.

images.actual_source_analysis: Vertical 4:5 natural color still life. Exactly three yellow-green pears occupy the lower-left half: one tall upright pear at far left, a broader upright pear in front and slightly right, and a third pear lying on its side behind them with its stem extending right. One pewter jug stands in the upper-right half; its oval open mouth has a left-facing short spout and a single large curved handle on the right. The dark brown oak tabletop fills the lower half and a textured charcoal plaster wall fills the upper half. Soft upper-left light exposes pear speckles, metal patina and linen weave. Use broad natural tonal transitions and a clean full-frame finish; no spotlight circle, black vignette, border or theatrical smoke.
Low-key rendering must not merge separate objects into a black mass; preserve overlap order, contact shadows and the gaps between silhouettes.
